truncated.description: Use truncation for long content within events (default: true)

truncate_buffer.description: Characters to show at start/end when truncating (default: 1000)

include_markers.description: Use interactive markers for frontend vs plain text for backend/LLM (default: true)

collapsed.description: Show summary vs full tree hierarchy for traces (default: false)

tools_collapse_threshold.description: Number of tools before collapsing the list (default: 5)

include_line_numbers.description: Prefix each line with line number (default: false)
